_comment: Things TrackerDB lists that Creepy Peeper should not raise a camera for. Applied by tools/build-registry.mjs.

trackers.google_tag: Google Tag Manager is a container, not a tracker. It is routinely used to *gate* tracking behind consent, so flagging it punishes the sites doing the right thing. Whatever GTM actually loads is detected on its own domain.

domains.w.org: WordPress.org's asset CDN. s.w.org serves the emoji sprite that core WordPress loads on every page, self-hosted or not, with no analytics involved. The Jetpack stats pixel this pattern is really about lives on stats.wp.com, which is still matched.
